notes: Instant Roblox disconnect recovery: embedded telemetry v2.1 monitors visible RobloxPromptGui error modals, detects Reconnect+Leave and ErrorPrompt Leave-only variants, captures error code/text and session/place metadata to a durable event mailbox, shuts down/kicks the errored client session, and lets Watchdog consume the event before normal PID/map/FPS checks for immediate rejoin. Hidden prompt templates are ignored via effective-visibility checks.
